title: First 14-day Surge Playbook and KPI Protocol
summary: Targeted playbook for the first 14 days after incremental launch (beta -> public). Focus: controlled traffic ramps, transparent KPI tracking, rapid rollback criteria, and communication choreography with SRE/Support/CS. This doc is intentionally operational — short syntax, checkboxes, and owner-first actions.
objectives: 1) Keep 99th percentile tail latency within SLA during 0->50% traffic increases. 2) Maintain error rate below 0.7% platform-wide. 3) Validate canary controls and fallback routes within 4 hours of signal. 4) Ensure clear escalation + customer comms cadence.
kpi_targets: Model quality regression (automatic evals): no >2% drop on core prompts
Cost per 1k tokens: track and keep within 15% of forecast
runway_tracker:
Day|Traffic %|SLO burn (token cost / latency)|Primary action
Day 0|0% (canary)|baseline capture|verify k/v cache priming, dry-run smoke test
Day 1|5%|light burn|monitor burst queues, enable batching 1->5
Day 3|15%|observe|increase autoscale floor, open support rota
Day 7|30%|stress|evaluate quantization profile, re-tune routing policy
Day 10|50%|stabilize|begin soft-promote, customer-facing comms
Day 14|>50%|steady|hand off to steady-state ops
checklist:
- [ ] Canary deployment validated (smoke + regression evals)
- [ ] Alerting configured for these KPIs and paging thresholds
- [ ] Cost telemetry dashboard added to launch room
- [ ] Support playbook and canned replies staged
- [ ] Rollback artifact (route and model pin) tested
- [ ] Customer-facing status template ready
- [ ] Postmortem owner assigned if any P1 occurs
escalation_matrix: Level 1 (on-call): triage alerts -> pages SRE (pager SRE-team) -> slack #launch-control
Level 2 (engineer lead): if degraded after 10m, bring in infra-owner + model-owner
Level 3 (commander): if SLA >30m or >1% user-impact, exec notify + CS comms
Fallback: trigger model-variant routing to a compatible lower-cost variant per routing policy
immediate_actions: OPS-1423: Create `launch-room` dashboard (tickets linked) — owner: Jonas — due: D-1
PR 87: Add KPI annotations to console dashboard — reviewer: Ethan — merge by D-2
Confluence page update: add canned support messages + rollback steps — owner: Maya — D-1
SLA smoke exercises: run 3x spike tests at 3x expected peak traffic — owner: SRE — day 0
acceptance_criteria:
- Canary passes 1000 synthetic prompts with no quality regression and error rate <0.5% over 30m.
- Latency SLOs met in canary region for two 1-hour windows separated by 6 hours.
- Cost telemetry shows no >30% spike relative to forecast for 2 consecutive hours.
communication_plan:
- Internal: launch-room channel + hourly triage stand for first 72h, then cadence moves to every 4h.
- External: CS template on Day 3 if any visible user impact, status page update only for P1/P0 events.
- Exec digest: morning summary on Day 1/4/7/14 or on-demand for P1.
postmortem_notebook: Capture: timeline, decision points, metric deltas (pre-post), root cause hypothesis, mitigations, timeline-to-fix. Attach graph snippets (latency, eps, error rate), and mark owners for follow-ups (A-C list).
risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: KV cache cold-starts causing tail latency spikes. Mitigation: warm-up traffic pattern + pre-warm cache on Day 0.
Risk: Sudden model quality drift after traffic increases. Mitigation: hold canary at 15% and run regression eval set, enable auto-fallback to previous pinned model.
Risk: Cost overshoot. Mitigation: enable throttled batching and cost-alerts at 20% above forecast.
notes: This is a living doc — prefer quick edits in the launch-room during operations rather than perfect prose. If you change KPI thresholds, increment the version in the Confluence page and ping the exec owner. Lean conservative on promotes; the default is to hold on aggressive traffic shifts unless all three signal classes (latency, error, quality) are green.
